news.title: Ahmedabad: New rules propose FIRs for unauthorised demolitions
news.para: Ahmedabad's town development department has drafted a new demolition policy for sustainable redevelopment. This policy aims to ensure citizen safety and environmental protection during property demolitions. Property owners and contractors will face penalties and police complaints for flouting regulations. Structures exceeding specific sizes will require detailed assessment and management plans. Strict compliance with safety and environmental rules is mandatory for all demolition activities.

news.title: Chandigarh housing board clears need-based changes in houses, lifts in all dwelling units
news.para: The Chandigarh Housing Board has greenlit essential adjustments for independent homes, allowing lifts in all CHB residences without needing consent from every resident. Additionally, the installation of solar panels can proceed without CHB authorization under a government initiative. These innovative measures are designed to meet persistent requests from residents and enhance overall housing amenities.

news.title: Karnataka HC quashes ₹482-crore penalty on ACC, directs government to execute mining lease
news.para: The standoff escalated in 2025 when the department issued a revised royalty demand of Rs 367.51 crore (after adjusting Rs 125 crore already deposited by the firm), followed by a separate penalty notice of Rs 482.70 crore under the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh eases land-use rules, cuts conversion fees to speed up clearances
news.para: Development authorities are now authorized to modify land usage for plots up to 6,000 sqm, streamlining a process that formerly required tedious state-level approvals. This significant change not only halves the land-use conversion fees but also accelerates the approval of maps and layout plans by the GDA. As a result, construction timelines are reduced, effectively easing the financial pressures on both buyers and developers.

news.title: HC restrains GMDA inspection at two group housing flats in Gurgugram in alteration row
news.para: In a significant legal development, the Punjab and Haryana High Court has issued a directive preventing the GMDA from conducting inspections on two group housing flats. This ruling arose from a contentious issue concerning alleged unauthorized modifications made by the owner. The court took action following the owner's challenge to repeated inspection attempts.

news.title: Odisha: NGT admits appeal against environmental clearance granted to stone quarry in Jajpur
news.para: The National Green Tribunal has accepted a petition contesting the environmental clearance granted for a black stone quarry, filed by a concerned local resident who claims environmental regulations were breached. Notices have been sent to both the authorities and the private quarry lessee for their replies. A hearing is scheduled for September 30, where an interim plea will also be addressed.

news.title: Stilt violations razed, shops sealed as drive resumes in two Gurugram colonies
news.para: In a crackdown on unauthorized construction and violations of land use, authorities targeted several properties in Sushant Lok and South City. Enforcement teams sealed off and demolished more than seventeen buildings, citing issues such as unauthorized floors, illegal paying guest accommodations, and the misuse of stilt parking spaces. The department intends to maintain its vigilant stance against similar illegal activities in the future.

news.title: Homebuyers await clearance as 176 recovery cases worth ₹106.7 crore remain pending in Pune district
news.para: Pune homebuyers are experiencing frustrating delays in receiving their due compensation and refunds. With one hundred seventy-six MahaRERA recovery cases worth over Rs 106 crore pending, many individuals have been left waiting for years to reclaim their funds. The situation is further exacerbated by properties that cannot be traced and unsuccessful auctions, as revenue officials point to administrative challenges and tracking difficulties contributing to these ongoing delays.

news.title: Uttar Pradesh forms panel to examine map adherence, fund use in Jaypee Wish Town on buyers’ complaint
news.para: A committee is set to assess Suraksha Group's performance at Jaypee Wish Town following concerns raised by homebuyers regarding irregularities. These issues have initiated a government probe into the construction's adherence to compliance standards. While Suraksha Group asserts substantial progress in line with the NCLT resolution plan, several buyers still express dissatisfaction with construction quality and discrepancies in the calculation of super areas.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh lifts freeze on registration of nine lakh acres of freehold assigned lands
news.para: The government has officially approved the registration of approximately nine lakh acres of freehold assigned lands, lifting a long-standing transaction freeze. This pivotal move decentralizes authority, enabling revenue divisional officers and sub-collectors to grant freehold rights beyond municipal corporations. An impressive seven lakh acres of assigned land will be processed legally, offering assignees increased economic autonomy over their properties.

news.title: Juniper Hotels to acquire Novotel Imagicaa for ₹248 crore
news.para: Juniper Hotels has approved the proposed acquisition of Novotel Imagicaa in Khopoli, Maharashtra, from Imagicaaworld Entertainment for ₹248 crore. The operating hotel comprises 287 keys across approximately 11 acres and 2.8 lakh sq ft of built-up area.

news.title: SC directs ED, Delhi Police to submit details of cases against Unitech directors
news.para: The Supreme Court has mandated that trials for Unitech directors proceed without delay, urging investigative bodies to present case particulars swiftly. Agencies are diligently tracing homebuyers' funds to ascertain their status. A dedicated court has been established to address these issues specifically, ensuring that homebuyers are not further inconvenienced and can eventually access their dream homes.

news.title: DRA acquires 10-acre land parcel in Chennai for ₹159 crore
news.para: DRA has acquired a 10-acre land parcel off OMR near Thazhambur in South Chennai for ₹159 crore. The company plans to develop about 1.55 million sq ft of residential space with an estimated GDV of ₹1,200 crore.

news.title: Delhi panel decides to set up portals for mapping student accommodation needs, PG registration
news.para: In a significant move, the Delhi government is set to launch online portals within the next fifteen days to effectively address student accommodation requirements. One of these will specifically focus on registering paying guest facilities along with essential safety information. Additionally, the authorities are in the process of drafting new laws and regulations related to this type of housing.

news.title: Delhi government to develop hostels for 10,000 students, land being identified: CM
news.para: The Delhi government is set to establish hostel facilities accommodating ten thousand students, catering to the increasing need for state-operated student housing. These hostels will be built across multiple institutions and in collaboration with private partners. A comprehensive policy is in development to guarantee safe and adequate accommodation for students throughout the city. This initiative comes in response to a recent incident highlighting the dangers of unsafe paying guest accommodations.

news.title: Mohali: GMADA fails to answer IT City plot owners’ queries, public hearing postponed to Sept 29
news.para: Gmada has decided to delay a public hearing regarding the increased plot prices for IT City. Plot owners raised critical questions about the justification for the proposed charges. Unfortunately, officials failed to clarify the costs associated with land acquisition. To better address these issues, the meeting has been rescheduled for September 29. Gmada will also issue outstanding certificates to plot owners.

news.title: Delay in nod for phase-II tender holds up new metro work in Gurugram
news.para: The extension of the Gurugram metro to Cyber City is likely to be delayed beyond its 2029 deadline due to pending civil construction tenders for the Sector 9 to Cyber City segment. This setback impacts the overall construction and testing schedules. Additionally, changes in leadership and funding issues have previously hindered progress. Quick decision-making is essential to meet a revised completion timeline.

news.title: IWG signs 43 new locations in India in H1 2026; country becomes third-largest growth market
news.para: International Workplace Group signed 43 new locations in India during H1 2026, making the country its third-largest growth market globally. The company currently operates 125 centres across 37 Indian cities and has more than 200 centres in the pipeline.

news.title: Patna civic bodu collects ₹93 lakh property tax in one-day drive
news.para: In a significant revenue boost, Patna Municipal Corporation collected upwards of Rs 93 lakh in property tax on Tuesday, with the Patliputra circle contributing Rs 67.99 lakh from 129 properties. To identify untaxed homes, officials engaged in door-to-door outreach and site checks. Property owners should note that taxes must be paid by September 30 to sidestep penalties.

news.title: Chandigarh housing board set to widen scope of need-based changes for independent homes
news.para: The Chandigarh Housing Board is set to introduce enhanced rebuilding options for independent house owners. Under new regulations, homeowners may now have the option to demolish and reconstruct their residences, a notable shift in policy. The allowable covered area may rise from fifty to seventy percent to align with other house types. Additionally, lifts may be installed to boost accessibility, reflecting the objective of adapting to modern living standards.
